mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% within the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in private sector employment (PAYEMS) signals coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines and PAYEMS increases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market expansion (HOUST above 1200 thousand units), rising residential construction drives consumer confidence and corporate investment, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1200, or Rank IC over 4 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index base 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100, or Rank IC over 2 years drops below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months reflects robust consumer spending, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where RSAFS increases over 3 months, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates synchronized expansion across housing and manufacturing sectors, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO increase, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.5% annually), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, causing equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.
